tldr: The Sun in Leo: identity built through expression, visibility, and creative warmth.
body: With the Sun in Leo, the core self strengthens through being seen, creating boldly, and leading from the heart. The Sun is at home in Leo, so confidence works cleanly when it has a generous purpose.
gift: Magnetic presence, creative leadership, warmth, courage, and the ability to energize a room.
challenge: Pride, vanity, drama, or measuring your value by applause instead of integrity.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
